title: Chatdom teaser: the kingdom's own ambience

formats.raw: WAV, 48 kHz, stereo, 32-bit float, as rendered (media .../ambience/raw/; bed layers in raw/layers/)

levels: Beds: linear gain to -28 LUFS integrated, true peak kept below -6 dBTP. Hero sounds: linear gain so the true peak sits at -6 dBTP. Measured with ffmpeg ebur128 (peak=true) and astats.

rerender.how: Builds the bench page (apps/studio/sound/ambience/index.html, main.ts) with Vite, takes the shared capture lock, renders every layer in headless Chromium through OfflineAudioContext on the first free capture port, closes the browser and server and releases the lock, then mixes, loops, measures and normalises in Node with ffmpeg (nice -n 19, -threads 4). Deterministic: every render is seeded.

notes: Soul audio (packages/audio/src/soul, renderSoulAudio) is not used: it always plays its own music (lute, and strings, woodwind and choir with presence) and has no switch to turn that off, which would clash with the score. The Genesis land layer it reuses for birds, harbour and water is used directly instead.

The Genesis land has no people in it by design (population: real-presence-only). The evening murmur and the fire are therefore authored for the teaser in apps/studio/sound/ambience (murmur.ts, fire.ts) and are labelled so; they are not package sounds.
Door: the kingdom has no door cue (packages/audio cues are wood, light, wave, beacon, step, place, remove, material; the moment cues have none either). No door sound was made.
The bell buoy is the Genesis land's own call (rung by the swell; the light mist in the night bed makes it speak more often). Whether it rings, and when, comes from the seed.
Owls and blackbirds come from the meadow soul of the observed fixture 4363967; the coastal fixture 63920635 would give oystercatchers and curlews instead and no owl.
Inputs are chosen for the teaser shots (hour, weather, ear position, the Forge schedule, the passers-by): they are not events from a real kingdom.

files.what: Evening town bed, a seamless 30 s loop. Dusk on the harbour town: the sea breaking left and right and lapping at the quay, rigging and hulls, a few gulls, blackbirds and a wood pigeon settling, a frog by the water, crickets just starting; people talking a street away (now and then a laugh), a hearth crackling through an open window, three passers-by on the cobbles and the boardwalk.
files.shots: S01 the channel at dusk; S05-S07 the Way Home at golden hour (the walk to their door, the window lights, the door opens); S08 chat becomes lights, under the window wave.
